title: Emirp twins
plain: Show infinitely many twin-prime pairs exist where both reverse to primes, assuming only standard sieve bounds plus one level-of-distribution hypothesis.
math: Assuming Elliott–Halberstam, prove infinitely many $p$ with $p,p+2,\operatorname{rev}(p),\operatorname{rev}(p+2)$ prime among bounded gaps of tuples $(p,p+h)$, $h\le H$ explicit.
